name: 劉威辰
objective:
本課程旨在訓練學生公開表達之能力，內容包括語言表達基本原則與技巧、肢體語言與演講要領，備題演講及即席演講演練。
This course is designed to enable students to develop the principles and skills necessary for public speaking. Included will be guidelines for giving a speech and displaying body language, as well as practice sessions for delivering prepared speeches and impromptu speeches.

WEEK 2: Workshop (1): How to build your vocabulary (collocations)
WEEK 3: Show and Tell

WEEK 5: Show and Tell

WEEK 7: Workshop (2): How to speak naturally (chunking)

WEEK 10: Holiday

WEEK 12: Learn from great examples—Walter Mitty

WEEK 14: Picture-Based Speech
WEEK 15: Learn from great examples—Finding Neverland

remarks:
第十七週: Introducing “Recommendation Speech”
1. 類別: 遠距教學
2. 內容: 以 Google Meet 方式向學生介紹 recommendation speech 的結構與訣竅
3. 時數: 兩小時
4. 學習成果: 填寫課程學習單
5. 評量比例: 為評量方式 "Handouts" 項目下的一環，本週成果約占學期總成績 2%

第十八週: Online Personalized Feedback
1. 類別: 其他
2. 內容: 以 Google Meet 方式與學生進行一對一晤談，討論本學期學習心得與可以在英語演講上面更加精進的地方
3. 時數: 兩小時
4. 學習成果: 填寫學習訪談問卷
5. 評量比例: 為評量方式 "Handouts" 項目下的一環，本週成果約占學期總成績 2%
